name: Chana Masala
description: Pakistani chana masala with tender chickpeas simmered in a tangy onion-tomato masala with ginger, green chillies and warm spices.
ingredients: 3 cups cooked chickpeas, tender and drained with some cooking liquid reserved
Salt to taste and fresh coriander for finishing
method: Heat the oil in a pot, add the cumin seeds and let them become aromatic, then add the onions and cook until golden.
Stir in the ginger-garlic paste, followed by the tomatoes, green chillies, coriander powder, red chilli, turmeric and salt.
Cook the masala until the tomatoes have broken down and the mixture looks cohesive, stirring often so the spices do not catch on the base.
Add the already tender chickpeas with a little reserved cooking liquid and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes so they absorb the masala flavour.
Mash a small portion of the chickpeas against the side of the pot and stir them back into the gravy for natural body without turning the whole dish into a paste.
Adjust the gravy with a little more chickpea liquid if needed, then finish with garam masala and fresh coriander.
Taste for salt and chilli and serve hot with roti, naan or rice.
